create procedure CDN.DzlSciezka @SourceName VARCHAR(255), @SourceDatabase VARCHAR(255), @p_DzlId int, @returns varchar(255) OUTPUT as begin
declare @Sciezka varchar(255) declare @Kod varchar(255) declare @Dzl_ID int declare @Dzl_LokId int declare @Dzl_Poziom int declare @DZL_ParentId int
DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(4000) DECLARE @params NVARCHAR(4000)
select @sql = N' select @Kod= case when DZL_LokId=1 then DZL_Kod else '''' end, @DZL_ID=DZL_ParentId, @Dzl_Poziom=DZL_Poziom, @DZL_ParentId=DZL_ParentId from ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase +'].CDN.Dzialy where DZL_DzlId=@p_DzlId ' SELECT @params =N'@p_DzlId int, @Kod varchar(255) OUTPUT, @Dzl_ID int OUTPUT, @Dzl_Poziom int OUTPUT, @DZL_ParentId int OUTPUT' EXEC sp_executesql @sql, @params, @p_DzlId, @Kod OUTPUT,@Dzl_ID OUTPUT,@Dzl_Poziom OUTPUT,@DZL_ParentId OUTPUT
set @Sciezka=@Kod
if @Sciezka is null or @Sciezka='brak' or @DZL_ParentId is null SET @returns ='' else begin while @DZL_ID<>0 and @Kod is not null and @Dzl_Poziom>2 begin select @sql = N' select @Kod=Dzl_Kod,@DZL_ID=DZL_ParentId,@Dzl_Poziom=DZL_Poziom from ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase +'].CDN.Dzialy where DZL_DzlId=@DZL_ID ' SELECT @params =N' @Kod varchar(255) OUTPUT, @Dzl_ID int OUTPUT, @Dzl_Poziom int OUTPUT' EXEC sp_executesql @sql, @params, @Kod OUTPUT,@Dzl_ID OUTPUT,@Dzl_Poziom OUTPUT
if @Sciezka='' set @Sciezka=@Kod else set @Sciezka=@Kod+'.'+@Sciezka end
if @Sciezka is null set @Sciezka='<nieprawidłowy dział>'
SET @returns =@Sciezka end end
